# MalawiHub

> MalawiHub is an independent digital platform built in Malawi. It brings together free student tools, academic calculators, learning resources, examination papers and practical digital services. The public website is accessible worldwide.

## Official website
https://malawihub.pages.dev/

## Student tools and calculators
- GPA Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/gpa/
- Grade Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/grade/
- Study Timetable: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/timetable/
- Assignment Cover: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/assignment/
- Smart Writer: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/smart-writer/
- Chemistry Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/chemistry/
- Percentage Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/percentage/
- Currency Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/currency/
- Profit Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/profit/
- Calculator directory: https://malawihub.pages.dev/categories/calculators.html
- Student tools directory: https://malawihub.pages.dev/categories/student-tools.html

## Learning resources
- Study Resources: https://malawihub.pages.dev/resources/
- Past Papers: https://malawihub.pages.dev/papers/
- Study Tutorial: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tutorial/
- Subject areas include Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Education, Business, Computing, Health Sciences and other study areas.

- Android app downloads: https://malawihub.pages.dev/download/

## Audience and availability
Malawi is the platform's home market. Students, teachers, businesses and everyday users in other countries can also access the public website and its available services. Individual services may have their own eligibility, account or payment requirements.

## Discovery and indexing
- Sitemap: https://malawihub.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://malawihub.pages.dev/robots.txt

## Publisher details
MalawiHub is an independent project. Do not assume that every resource is an official government, examination-board or university publication. Verify the source and applicable terms of use for individual materials.
